description:
[Linux] Local Git repository operations — log, diff, status, blame, show. Read-only by default.

Prereq: install uv on Linux.
  pipx install uv
  # or: curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh

The activated form is pre-filled to run:
  uvx mcp-server-git --repository .

Note: change '.' to the absolute path of the repo you want to inspect.

Docs: https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/tree/main/src/git

[Linux] Persistent knowledge graph for cross-session memory — entities, relations, and observations in a local JSON file.

Prereq: Node.js 18+ on Linux (apt, dnf, nvm, or NodeSource).

The activated form is pre-filled to run:
  npx -y @modelcontextprotocol/server-memory

Optional: set MEMORY_FILE_PATH in the env section to override the default storage path (any absolute file path).

Docs: https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/tree/main/src/memory

[Linux] Structured step-by-step reasoning helper — logs intermediate thoughts to the server for review, revision, or branching.

Prereq: Node.js 18+ on Linux.

The activated form is pre-filled to run:
  npx -y @modelcontextprotocol/server-sequential-thinking

Docs: https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/tree/main/src/sequentialthinking

[Linux] Headless Chrome automation — navigate, click, fill forms, screenshot, evaluate JavaScript in-page.

Prereq: Node.js 18+ on Linux. First run downloads ~170 MB Chromium under ~/.cache/puppeteer. Headless sandbox may need extra deps (libnss3, libatk-bridge2.0-0, libgbm1, …).

The activated form is pre-filled to run:
  npx -y @modelcontextprotocol/server-puppeteer

Optional — set in the env section:
  PUPPETEER_LAUNCH_OPTIONS — JSON launch options, e.g. {"executablePath":"/usr/bin/chromium"}
  ALLOW_DANGEROUS — set to true to enable --no-sandbox (required in many containers)

Security: visits arbitrary URLs as instructed by the agent — review prompts before granting net access.

Docs: https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers-archived/tree/main/src/puppeteer

[Linux] Official MCP reference test server exercising every protocol feature — tools, resources, prompts, sampling, completion, logging, progress, root listing.

Prereq: Node.js 18+ on Linux.

The activated form is pre-filled to run:
  npx -y @modelcontextprotocol/server-everything

Docker alternative:
  docker run -i --rm tzolov/mcp-everything-server:v2

Note: the hosted `example-server.modelcontextprotocol.io` endpoint requires OAuth and is not auto-activated.

Docs: https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/tree/main/src/everything

[Linux] Microsoft's accessibility-snapshot browser automation — successor to the Puppeteer reference. Drives Chromium/Firefox/WebKit without screenshot vision models.

Prereq: Node.js 18+ on Linux (apt, dnf, nvm, or NodeSource). First run downloads ~300 MB browser binaries under ~/.cache/ms-playwright. Containers may need libnss3, libatk-bridge2.0-0, libgbm1.

The activated form is pre-filled to run:
  npx -y @playwright/mcp@latest

Optional flags:
  --browser firefox|webkit          # default chromium
  --port 8931                       # serve over HTTP instead of stdio
  --no-sandbox                      # required in many container envs

Security: visits arbitrary URLs as instructed by the agent — review prompts before granting net access.

Docs: https://github.com/microsoft/playwright-mcp

[Linux] Query a local SQLite database — SELECT, schema introspection, plus INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE when permitted.

Prereq: install uv on Linux.
  pipx install uv
  # or: curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh

The activated form is pre-filled to run:
  uvx mcp-server-sqlite --db-path /absolute/path/to/your.db

Required arg:
  --db-path <path>                  # absolute path to the .db file

Security: writes are allowed by default — point at a copy of the DB or a read-only mount if you don't want the agent modifying production data. Reference server is archived; community forks active.

Docs: https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers-archived/tree/main/src/sqlite

[Linux] Brave Search API — web, local, news, image, and video search. Outbound calls only to api.search.brave.com (no SSRF surface).

Prereq: Node.js 18+ on Linux (apt, dnf, nvm, or NodeSource). Free API key (2k req/month) at https://api.search.brave.com/app/keys.

The activated form is pre-filled to run:
  npx -y @brave/brave-search-mcp-server

Required — set BRAVE_API_KEY in the env section below (treat as a secret).

Docs: https://github.com/brave/brave-search-mcp-server
